objectives.text: Find a way through the locked corridor
Retrieve the master key from the safe

bw-east-foyer.text: Check the reception desk — there's something hidden inside.
The bulletin board has a ward code. Note it down.
Head through the corridor — the ward gate is ahead.

bw-patient-corridor.text: The ward B gate uses a number code. Check patient room 7 for the admission number.
The corridor branches. Explore patient room 7 or the nurses' station.

bw-patient-room-7.text: Patient 7's file has an unusual number sequence circled in red.
Check the cabinet — there may be something useful.
You've found what you need here. Move on.

bw-nurses-station.text: The terminal password might be the name of this place.
The medicine cabinet has supplies. Check inside.
Terminal solved. Check what it unlocked.

bw-treatment-room.text: Match the wire colours to the diagram on the wall.
Power is restored to Ward B. New areas are accessible.

bw-records-vault.text: The filing cabinet labels show a symbol sequence — that's your cipher key.
Check both records cabinets for files.
You found the director's office key. Head there next.

bw-directors-office.text: The safe combination is written somewhere in this room. Check the desk.
The master key is in the safe. Grab it.
You have the master key. Find the exit.

bw-chapel.text: Watch the bell sequence carefully — then repeat it in the same order.
The chapel alcove opened. Check inside.
Chapel complete. The tunnel entrance is nearby.

bw-solitary-cell.text: There's nothing useful here — only what they left behind. Read the walls.
The scratches on the wall might mean something. Note them.

bw-maintenance-tunnel.text: The hatch lock code uses two numbers. Read the pipe markings and wall carvings.
Agnes Colm, patient 07. The number 47 is on the pipe. Combine them.
The hatch is open. Escape through the tunnel.

catalogue.label: The Tunnel
catalogue.desc: Find and use the maintenance passage

catalogue.label: Caught
catalogue.desc: Security responds before you reach the exit

escaped.title: ESCAPED
escaped.flawless: The front doors groan open. Cold grey light. You step out into the morning without a single alarm raised, without a single mistake. Whatever lives in these walls stays in there.
escaped.clean: The master key turns. The lock disengages. You push through into the open air and don't look back.
escaped.alarm: The klaxon is still echoing as you clear the entrance. You run. The sound follows you three blocks before it fades.
escaped.fast: You were through Blackwood before it knew what was happening. The doors release and you're gone.
escaped.default: The front doors swing open. Pale morning light. Somewhere inside, something is still active — but you're out.

secret-escape.title: THE TUNNEL
secret-escape.noHints: The maintenance passage leads to open air behind the grounds. You found the way out that no one was supposed to find — entirely on your own. Whatever happened in Blackwood forty years ago, you've seen enough.
secret-escape.default: The hidden passage opens onto a drainage ditch behind the grounds. You're out. The morning is silent. Whatever lives in those walls stays in there.

time-out.title: LOCKED IN
time-out.nearExit: You were at the front doors. The master key was in your hand. Then the failsafe triggered — and no key opens a magnetically sealed exit.
time-out.manyMistakes: You triggered too many alarms. The lockdown sealed every exit long before the clock ran out.
time-out.default: The lights go out. The facility's failsafe triggers. A door seals somewhere that cannot be unsealed from inside. You are still in Blackwood.

alarm-caught.title: CAUGHT
alarm-caught.nearEscape: You had the exit in sight. Five more seconds and you'd have cleared the door. The security response was faster.
alarm-caught.default: Heavy boots on old tile. The response is swift and certain. You don't reach the exit in time.
